name: 5 Star Food Equipment
old_description: 5 Star Food Equipment sells & services commercial food equipment
about:
Based in Joplin, Missouri, 5 Star Food Equipment operates as a supplier and service provider for commercial food equipment. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company offers sales and service for commercial food equipment across 13 product categories: beverage and bar, cleaning and facility, concessions and food service, cooking equipment, dish washing equipment, food display and merchandising, food preparation, ice machines, plumbing, refrigeration, smallwares and kitchen accessories, storage and transportation, and tabletop. It states that it works on over 300 brands, covering both new equipment sales and repair of existing installations.

The firm serves restaurants, schools, hospitals, and other institutional food-service operators. Its category list indicates it also supports concessions, catering, and related food-service segments.

The company highlights its ability to service over 300 brands as a key differentiator, positioning itself as a single-source provider for both equipment procurement and ongoing maintenance.
